clickRightClickOrPress: Click, right-click or press ⌃ to pick an ammo, rocket or action for this slot. You can also drag slots to swap them. While editing the hotbar, add slots with + or remove any slot from its menu.
drainsTheTargetSShield: Drains the target's shield, never its hull, and adds every point drained to your own shield. Does nothing once the target's shield is empty. Consumed on every shot.
firesXDamageLaser: Fires x{mult} damage laser cells. Consumed on every shot.
guidedRocketFiredAt: Guided rocket fired at your target. Shares one cooldown with every rocket type.
dropsAProximityMine: Drops a proximity mine behind your ship.
loadsTheSalvoRack: Loads the Salvo Rack with this rocket type.
startsOrStopsAttacking: Starts or stops attacking your selected target.
jumpThroughTheGate: Jump through the gate you are standing on.
travelBackToYour: Travel back to your company base map.
firesAFullSalvo: Fires a full salvo from the rack. Needs a Salvo Rack and loaded ammo.
togglesTheRocketAutopilot: Toggles the rocket autopilot: fires automatically at your target. Also switchable from the use menu next to the hotbar.
togglesTheSalvoAutopilot: Toggles the salvo autopilot: fires the rack automatically. Also switchable from the use menu next to the hotbar.
firesYourHullSExclusive: Fires your hull's exclusive ability Every ship has a different one: the slot shows its icon and recharge.
togglesTheRepairSwarm: Toggles the repair swarm that restores hull while active. Also switchable from the use menu next to the hotbar.
cloaksYourShipUntil: Cloaks your ship until you attack. Uses one charge.
shieldSabotageAmmoDrains: Shield sabotage ammo: drains the target shield into yours.
pulseBarrierTip: Makes your ship invulnerable for {seconds} s. Uses one charge.
atomicBombTip: Detonates around your ship, hitting every enemy within {radius} px. Uses one charge.
fireworkTip: Launches a firework that spells PLANET WAR in the sky. No module needed. Uses one charge.
